optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
avg_customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       c.c_birth_day,
       c.c_birth_month,
       c.c_birth_year,
       c.c_birth_country,
       c.c_login,
       c.c_email_address,
       c.c_last_review_date_sk,
       ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state = 'AR'
JOIN customer_total_return ctr
  ON ctr.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN avg_customer_total_return av
  ON ctr.ctr_state = av.ctr_state
WHERE ctr.ctr_total_return > av.ctr_avg_total_return
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id,
         c.c_salutation,
         c.c_first_name,
         c.c_last_name,
         c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c.c_birth_day,
         c.c_birth_month,
         c.c_birth_year,
         c.c_birth_country,
         c.c_login,
         c.c_email_address,
         c.c_last_review_date_sk,
         ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
